what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. name: Tradie Ute
summary: Reference-led MQ body refinement: convex lower doors, inset shoulder and glass, crowned multi-section roof and rounded rear side glass. The nose substrate now sweeps back through intermediate facets instead of a square cap, and swept lamps share its geometry. Owner-tape tray/canopy envelopes and angular neutral accessories remain unchanged. Actual physics, hinges, pivots, anchors and collision buffers are frozen. Front styling is an estimate from the newer owner-model provenance; the local photos are rear oblique and uncalibrated.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: Authoritative real night photos and owner tape dimensions supersede the earlier Muse sheet, whose score only measures resemblance to a generated composite. See refs/measured-reference.json, measured-check.json and the validation report. Real photos are perspective, occluded and uncalibrated: no photo silhouette IoU is claimed. New local shape gates and baseline failure receipts are recorded in the current validation report.

damage.note: Left to right: intact; door_FL and door_RL loose; front and back loose; wheel_FL cambered; front detached; door_FL detached; back (tray and canopy) detached; wheel_FL detached; both front doors and the tray detached; a stripped shell. Posed in a three.js viewer about each part's hinge line; the host renderer cannot draw a second vehicle yet.

paints.pattern: Player colour on cab/body paint key. Canopy including lid, alloy tray, rack, awning, bar, glass, tyres and lamps remain neutral; roof number remains above the cab.
